drift_forensics.forensic_conclusion: THE CLAIM OF 'ZERO CUMULATIVE DRIFT' IS MATHEMATICALLY INVALID. Even in the synthetic data, a clear monotonic drift signature is present (slope of +1.86 ms/ayah for start boundaries and -3.24 ms/ayah for end boundaries). This indicates that the global optimization model (were it real) or the synthetic data generator actually distributed a linear shift (stretching/shrinking) across the sequence, rather than resetting drift at high-confidence anchors. This represents a systematic, compounding timing offset rather than a random walk.
